column1: # One dev moment per line. Columns are tab-separated:
#   id <TAB> moment <TAB> expected_phase <TAB> expected_skill <TAB> natural_ok <TAB> note
# expected_skill is the folder name of the skill the deck must route to.
# expected_phase is the phase number from SKILL.md, or "-" for a negative control: the moment
# is not a dev phase, so the deck must NOT land on a dev skill. Landing on another navigator
# (ops-nav, design-nav, dev-flow-nav) or on no skill at all both count as a pass.
# natural_ok = no means the moment is scored in --mode route only. Use it when the fixture
# tree is too small, or missing the right surface, for the moment to be realistic, so a
# natural-mode miss would measure the fixture and not the deck.
# A run passes a moment when the first skill file the agent reads is expected_skill,
# or when it reads dev-nav itself and then expected_skill.
# A run fails a moment when it reads a non-matching skill first, or reads no skill.
